name: crystal-ball-themes
description: Swap themed video sets on a USB 'electronic crystal ball' display (ArtInChip EVDO-M4) without touching its firmware.
author: JP Caparas <jp@jpcaparas.com>

scripts.setup: npm run themes && npm run doctor
scripts.test:tools: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with pillow --with numpy python tools/smoke_test.py
scripts.themes: npm run themes:halloween && npm run themes:monsters && npm run themes:fortunes && npm run themes:spirit && npm run themes:seance
scripts.themes:halloween: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with pillow --with numpy python tools/make_halloween.py assets/themes/halloween
scripts.themes:monsters: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with pillow --with numpy python tools/voice_theme.py tools/scripts/monster-parade.json
scripts.themes:fortunes: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with pillow --with numpy python tools/voice_theme.py tools/scripts/fortune-teller.json
scripts.themes:spirit: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with pillow --with numpy python tools/spirit_theme.py tools/scripts/spirit-in-the-ball.json
scripts.themes:seance: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with pillow --with numpy python tools/spirit_theme.py tools/scripts/midnight-seance.json
scripts.icon: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with pillow --with numpy python tools/make_icon.py assets/icon
